40 of 132 served tools were never called in the retained sample, and reflow2 cannot tell "unused" from "unreachable"

*Measured 2026-08-01 by tools/surface_usage.py, the sixth instrument and the first to measure the SURFACE rather than the engine — 46 retained Claude Code transcripts, 2026-07-18 to 2026-08-01, 6,095 reflow2 tool calls across 10 projects. Anthony's idea.* Never called: add_environment, add_flow, add_resource, alternatives_for, analyze_alternatives, apply_merge, arrival_delta, budget_report, calibrated_against, claim_region, claim_report, collapse_decision, compose_and_analyse, the four content_* tools, decomposes, dimension_drift, evidence_report, ingest_step, merge_designs, mint_seat, mirror_surface, mirrors, pair_designs, part_of_flow, performed_in, plan_epoch, recall_resolutions, reconcile_dependencies, reconcile_deployment, register_alternative, release_claim, seam_report, set_epoch_status, set_evidence_scope, set_project_mode, set_requirement_designation, withdraw_defect_acknowledgement. THE CAVEAT IS LOAD-BEARING AND MUST TRAVEL WITH THE NUMBER: absence here is WEAK evidence. Calibrated against a known case — set_project_mode appears as TEXT in ten transcripts and has ZERO recorded calls, although reflow2's own project was set to rigid with it. So a tool can be discussed far more than used, a tool used before the retention window is indistinguishable from one never used, and this session's own transcript was still being written. What the list is good for is the QUESTION, not the verdict: three distinct explanations sit in it and they want different answers. (a) Genuinely young — calibrated_against and set_evidence_scope shipped hours before the measurement and are not yet reachable from a running server, so of course they are zero. (b) Whole subsystems nobody has had cause to drive — the content store (4 tools), the claim/seat/merge family (7), composition and pairing (5). Each is built, tested and shipped; none has met its use case yet, which is a finding about the ROADMAP, not the tools. (c) The uncomfortable middle — evidence_report, seam_report, budget_report, dimension_drift, analyze_alternatives, arrival_delta are READS that answer real questions on designs that exist today, and nobody reaches for them. That is the same disease as [BL-154] one layer over: a capability nobody can find is worth what an absent one is worth. Fix shape, and it is measurement before code: re-run the instrument after retention improves, and for group (c) specifically ask whether the tool is unreachable from any skill or nudge that would name it — evidence_report gained three new axes this very release and appears in no skill.
